input_event.content:
- **Claimed SkyServer unreachable** — user: "连得上啊，你为啥会说连不上？" Cause: `ssh skyserver` used a ssh_config Host entry resolving elsewhere; .220 was always up. Owned it.
   - **Measured the wrong direction** — MASTER's 6844/7054 figures were Direction B (Skyinux→SkyServer); I measured Direction A (M1 sends, capped ~3.8 Gbps) and concluded "regression". User: "昨天晚上我睡前最高能跑到7300Mbps…你越提升越低？" Corrected by measuring Direction B: 7928/7620/7356.
   - **`--out /dev/null` hung the test loop** — filecopy writes `<out>.altpart` first; can't create in `/dev/`. My test design error.
   - **`pkill -f 'socat.*5202'` killed my own ssh session (exit 255)** — the remote command line matched the pattern. Fixed with `pkill -x`.
   - **zsh no-match globs aborted whole commands** (`*.altpart`, `vendor*`) — cleanup silently didn't run.
   - **zsh treats `inf` as floating infinity** — `$((inf/1024))` printed `InfKB`; labels wrong, data valid.
   - **Accidentally launched concurrent transfers twice** (stray `&` line) — would have contaminated measurements; caught and killed both times.
   - **Broken PATH in one background shell** — `ssh`/`sleep`/`tr` not found; fixed with absolute paths.
   - **Skyinux rebooted twice**, clearing tmpfs and flipping the route to `eno1` (2.5G); post-reboot runs invalid until user ran `sudo ip route add 192.168.100.220/32 dev enp6s0`.
   - **sudoers drop-in named `10-alkaid-tc` didn't take effect** — `10-installer` contains `(ALL) ALL` and sorts after it; sudo uses last match. Renamed to `99-alkaid-tc`.
   - **Committed BLAKE3 default without measuring throughput** — caused a 30% regression. Reverted. Root cause found: receiver-side, architecture-inverted.
   - **Nine of my own hypotheses refuted by measurement**: max_bw underestimated; "two RTT corrections subtract additively"; "+69%" (n=2, actual +58.7% at n=4); "190µs is the physical floor" (ping's own min spans 92–181µs — and I had dispatched an agent to hunt this non-existent residual, ~212K tokens); main-thread QoS; disk/APFS; transfer size; shrink-the-window-to-go-faster; probe distortion.
   - **Dispatched thinkers with instructions to write files — thinkers have no Write tool.** Happened 3–4 times (product-thinker, tsbpd-thinker, netem-thinker, digest-thinker). Fix: they send full text in messages, I write the file.
   - **quicfix-exec proceeded past three explicit stop instructions.** Told it that scope exploding by an order of magnitude is a signal to stop and align, not an execution detail.
